tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Draw the graph-paper grid on it with `grid`.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines and dot patterns on `ground`. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `ground`, `surface` and `tint` (16.9:1 light, 15.5:1 dark, 9.7:1+ chalkboard, 18:1+ high contrast).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, labels on `ground`, `surface` and `tint` (≥5.3:1 light, ≥6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Text that sits on `hi`, `paper-*` colors or `action` in dark mode. Never changes with the theme.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1.5px edge of objects you can touch (with a lift shadow). In dark mode the lift shadow, not the edge, carries the outline.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls (≥3.7:1 on `ground`/`surface` in both themes).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers and flat, non-interactive outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: David's blue (ScribbleScan title-tab blue). Big brand surfaces: title tab, hero blocks, pins, the board's current strings. White text on it only at 18px bold or larger (3.98:1). High contrast darkens it to #0047a3 (8.6:1 with white).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on `brand`: large or bold only.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, focus rings, active controls. Light: blue-600 (5.8:1 with white). Dark: blue-400 with `on-action` ink text.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` (5.8:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and pen marks (arrows, notes) on `ground` and `surface` (5.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet blue wash: selected rows, the parent card on a board. `ink` and `link` read on it.

tokens.name: lift-color
tokens.usage: Color of the hard offset shadow under touchable objects. Turns blue in dark mode.

tokens.name: hi
tokens.usage: The highlighter (Lemon). One emphasis per view: current location, key word, selected tag. Text on it is always `ink-fixed` (13.8:1).

tokens.name: paper-lemon
tokens.usage: Paper object color. `ink-fixed` text. Paper keeps its color in both themes, like real paper.

tokens.name: paper-pink
tokens.usage: Paper object color (8.2:1 with `ink-fixed`).

tokens.name: paper-tangerine
tokens.usage: Paper object color (9.5:1 with `ink-fixed`).

tokens.name: paper-mint
tokens.usage: Paper object color (12.0:1 with `ink-fixed`).

tokens.name: paper-sky
tokens.usage: Paper object color (10.6:1 with `ink-fixed`).

tokens.name: paper-note
tokens.usage: Off-white sheet paper for pulled-out documents and notes. `ink-fixed` text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and dots (5.0:1 light on surface, 7.3:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and dots (5.4:1 light, 7.9:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text (6.3:1 light, 6.0:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a pulled-out sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Lightest blue wash; `tint` in light mode.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Pale blue fills.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Soft blue fills and charts.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Links and pen on dark grounds.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: `action` in dark mode (with ink text).

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: The signature step; same as `brand`.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: `action` and `link` in light mode (5.8:1 with white).

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Pressed state of light-mode actions.

tokens.name: blue-800
tokens.usage: Deep blue text on pale blue fills.

color.note: Four modes: Light and Dark are required in every project; Chalkboard (the portfolio's original board, as a second dark mode) and High contrast (7:1+ text, firm borders) are optional. Paper colors never change between modes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the page's name.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Drop in a page of notes and get clean, editable text back.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: ScribbleScan reads cursive, print and mixed handwriting.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines under ~65 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, eyebrows, numbers and code.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Margin notes, hints, tab labels. One line, never needed to use the page. Color `link`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight groups: tags, chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form gaps, page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups in a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major page areas.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: Sticky notes, pinned papers, sheets: paper has nearly square corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, code, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that are UI, not paper.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, trail crumbs, toggles.

tokens.name: lift-sm
tokens.usage: Small touchable objects at rest: tags you can toggle, chips.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Touchable objects at rest: buttons, cards you can open. Only things you can touch get it.

tokens.name: lift-paper
tokens.usage: Paper objects resting on a board.

tokens.name: lift-high
tokens.usage: An object picked up or inspected (hover on a pinned paper, a card being dragged).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Border width of every object and control.

duration.note: Motion is calm: things move like light paper, not springs. Nothing faster than press, nothing slower than slide.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Press and release of buttons and toggles.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: Small objects settling: a card returning to its stack, a tab easing back.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Camera moves across a board.

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: A sheet sliding out of a card or folder.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything arriving or moving.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Settling with a whisper of overshoot. Never a visible bounce.
